caption:
The AI added a font preload to speed up the first paint. The Network tab now shows inter.woff2 downloaded twice, and the console warns the preload wasn't used.

Look at the card. Fonts are always fetched in CORS mode, even from your own domain. A preload without crossorigin is fetched in a different mode, so the browser can't reuse it when the font is actually needed, and it downloads it again.

Add the crossorigin attribute with no value. Now the preload matches and the font downloads once, early.

Only preload the one or two fonts used above the fold. Preloading everything competes with your hero image.

Source: MDN, rel=preload (CORS-enabled fetches).
